pieces.title: Making the ECS Grant Visible in the Andover Budget
pieces.summary: A July 2026 letter to the Board of Finance, with the worked spreadsheets behind it, asking that the state's $2.08 million Education Cost Sharing grant be allocated between the Andover Elementary and RHAM appropriations and shown on the budget documents voters see. Spending does not change and the mill rate does not change; what changes is that the net local cost of each school budget becomes visible. It recommends rather than reports, so it sits here rather than among the reports.

pieces.title: The Votes Are the Job
pieces.summary: Why it is fair, and necessary, for Ellen Paul's campaign to make this race about Rep. Steve Weir's record. An incumbent starts with the title on the ballot, a caucus web page, and state-paid newsletters; what he carries that a challenger does not is two terms of recorded votes. Asking voters to read them is not a smear, it is the job review. Written by the co-chair of the Andover Democratic Town Committee, who says so up front, with every figure sourced to the official roll calls.
